title: finding(types,cli): `objectui validate` refuses 418 of the 419 registered NAMESPACED component types at `type`, all 28 namespaced ADR-0080 public blocks among them (`action:button`, `page:header`, `record:details`), the namespaced half of objectui#10859
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect family with named sites, class (a). `reach:` public door, measured. `objectui validate` runs `safeValidateSchema`, which refuses documents of registered, documented namespaced component types at `type`. Reader: triage first (grade and route; objectui#10859 is the bare-key half, so this may be its sub-issue or its second slice), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat #2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from the objectui#10859 batch-1 dev report (`5861203718`, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured (by the objectui#10859 batch-1 dev, on objectui `origin/main` `a60539b07`)

- objectui#10859 measured the 229 BARE keys of the registry list in `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`. The same list also carries **419 namespaced keys**.
- `safeValidateSchema({ type: KEY })` refuses **418 of the 419** at `type`. The one accepted key is `ui:calendar`.
- All 28 namespaced entries of the ADR-0080 `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` list are among the 418. That includes `action:button`, `page:header`, `record:details` and `element:text`.
- `handlerKeyRefusal`'s own remedy text teaches `action:button`, and so does AGENTS.md #4. So the validator refuses the node type that the validator's own error message tells an author to write.

## Read by this seat (objectui `origin/main` `f905090a1`)

- `git grep` for a namespaced discriminator literal (`literal('X:Y')`) across `packages/types/src/zod/` finds exactly one: `ui:calendar`.
- `AnyComponentSchema` in `index.zod.ts` is a `z.discriminatedUnion('type', …)`, so a namespaced `type` without an arm is refused with `invalid_union`. That agrees with the dev's 418.
- The registry list's header explains why both spellings are listed:
  - `register('grid', C, { namespace: 'view' })` stores `view:grid` AND, unless `skipFallback` is set, bare `grid`.
  - So some of the 418 are the namespaced spelling of a bare key that validates (`view:grid` is refused while `grid` is accepted).
  - Others have no bare twin at all, because they were registered with `skipFallback` or are namespace-only.
  - The measurement does not yet separate these two groups. The first step of any fix does.

## Why it matters

The namespaced vocabulary is the authoring surface the platform teaches: ADR-0080 public blocks, the page and record blocks, and the element family. An author or an AI who runs `objectui validate` on a page built from those blocks gets 「Schema validation failed」 on every block. One of two things is true:
- the validator does not cover the vocabulary the registry and docs publish;
- or namespaced documents are validated somewhere else, and `objectui validate` should say so instead of refusing.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- First, split the 418 into: namespaced spellings whose bare twin validates, and namespace-only keys. Then establish where namespaced blocks are MEANT to be validated. Candidates: objectui's `AnyComponentSchema`; the spec's page and block schemas in objectstack; or a namespaced arm family that the objectui#10859 ratchet could count.
- Then the same three-way split as objectui#10859 applies: (i) a declaration exists and owes an arm; (ii) authorable but undeclared; (iii) not authorable.
- The objectui#10859 ratchet counts only bare keys. Whether a namespaced count joins it is triage's call. ⛔ It adds no new gate; it widens an existing ratchet's population.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #10213), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- namespaced near validate / `safeValidateSchema` / `invalid_union` / `AnyComponentSchema`: 1 hit, PR objectui#10870 (the objectui#10859 batch 1 that reported this);
- `action:button` near refus / `invalid_union` / validate: 2 hits, objectui#10294 and #10272, neither about `type` refusal;
- `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` near refus / validate / arm: 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `objectui validate namespaced registered types` · `action:button invalid_union` · `PUBLIC_BLOCKS refused at type` · `namespaced registry key no AnyComponentSchema arm`
